scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed:trips && npm run db:seed:pokedex && npm run db:seed:hunts
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd app_react && npm install
scripts.combine:api: find app_api -type f -name '*.ts' -exec sh -c 'for f; do echo "$f :"; cat "$f"; echo ""; done' _ {} + > ../../api_code.txt
scripts.combine:react: find app_react/src -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -exec sh -c 'for f; do echo "$f:"; cat "$f"; echo ""; done' _ {} + > ../../react_code.txt
scripts.combine:shared: find shared -type f -name '*.ts' -exec sh -c 'for f; do echo "$f :"; cat "$f"; echo ""; done' _ {} + > ../../shared.txt
scripts.tree: tree app_react/src > ../../project_tree.txt && npm run tree:api && npm run tree:shared
scripts.combine:all: npm run combine:api && npm run combine:react && npm run combine:shared && npm run tree
